description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Gotabayapura Village, Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambanthota District   - Cad. Map No. 830078
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of ownership, property boundaries, and land titles. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
